value: Austin's currently-active Fire Code Sec. 1207.11.4 (2024 IFC, Group R-3/R-4 dwellings, effective July 10 2025, expressly based on NFPA 855-2023): individual ESS units capped at 20 kWh; aggregate capacity capped at 40 kWh in utility closets, basements, and storage/utility spaces, and 80 kWh in attached/detached garages, detached accessory structures, exterior walls, or outdoors on the ground. IMPORTANT for Base Core sizing: the code does not simply forbid exceeding these caps -- an ESS installation over the individual/aggregate ratings is instead required to comply with the general (non-residential) ESS provisions of Sections 1207.1-1207.9, i.e. it is reclassified rather than barred. Note: the 2024 edition added 'basements' to the 40 kWh tier, which was not present in the 2021-cycle text or the generic IRC R328/NFPA 855 summary.
quote: 1207.11.4 Energy Ratings Individual ESS units shall have a maximum rating of 20 kWh. The aggregate rating of the ESS shall not exceed: 40 kWh within utility closets, basements , and storage or utility spaces. 80 kWh in attached or detached garages and detached accessory structures. 80 kWh on exterior walls . 80 kWh outdoors on the ground. ESS installations exceeding the permitted individual or aggregate ratings shall be installed in accordance with Sections 1207.1 through 1207.9 . (Material based on NFPA 855 2023 Ed.)
